resources.allowTrivial: The grove is placed once when the scene is entered and nothing in this scene adds or removes a tree, so the count is a held invariant by design.
The four variants are generated in enter() and never regenerated, so their summed vertex count is held for the life of the scene.

Held by design at both framings: the asset pipeline's LOD bake refuses an alpha-masked primitive, so no leaf chain is ever baked and every leaf mesh draws its own authored LOD0. See FRICTION.md 6; a non-zero value here would mean a leaf silently lost detail.
